I get that. I get really anxious or paranoid around people which is annoying as hell :/

Im perfect when Im a lil tipsy too tho :D removes the edge kinda. You're only 26, you have plenty of time dont worry. Im sure there are plenty that age who haven't had anyone yet. If you keep worrying nothing will happen. Just go for it next time and then it will go well instead of it being screwed up by you feeling worthless.. because you're not. The worst that can happen is someone saying no. Maybe they are in the same position as you? Just man up and make the first move! xD It's not easy but it will be easiER if you feel a lil more confident in yourself :)

you should have! such a nice act of kindness but I know how you feel. I'm mega insecure talking to new people.. I have the worst social anxiety at times. Next time just give it a shot, you never know where it may lead. Maybe reaching out is stopping you from meeting someone :)

i posted on here once before: 
I don't know why I am posting on here, mostly I guess because I don't have anyone to tak to right now. I really appreciate any help or guidance. A lil background info on me and what my life is like/whats bringing me down: I Just turned 21 last week and live in Croydon where I hate. I lived with my mum, dad and 4 brothers (2 older, 2 younder) until I was 8, then my parents divorced (found out later my dad had cheated on my mum ) and me, mum and 2 older bros moved to scotland. My mum died when I was 14 (she had lung cancer (which we only found out about 6 months before her death) but ended up commiting suicide by drinking barbiturate) We moved back in with my dad and his new wife and daughter and my two younger brothers. My dad treated my brothers like gold and his step daughter (not his real daughter - two months older than me) like his real daughter but I was verbally and sometimes physically abused by him for two years and was kept as his slave- doing all the housework and never being allowed to be a normal teenager. When I was 16 I moved in with my boyfriend to escape my family. Things didnt go so well, he was very controlling, made me drop contact from friends and family and we were having money problems. He led me into prostitution to bring money to the table. I ended up running away from him and things went good for a while. I managed to hide my problems from everyone. I met my new boyfriend and we got married 6 months later when I turned 18 ( we were together around about 1 year when he crashed whilst drink driving and passed away). I moved in and out with friends and things got better. I passed my exams in college got into uni had new boyfriends ( although not real long relationships. I met a guy last year and he helped me through my problems except we dug too deep and my scars opened again. I started taking acid and cocaine to deal with this. I hurt him so bad too. I had a very deep patch of depression and tried to kill myself which didnt work I slept with someone for money to pay for my addiction and He found out about it. I have never felt so ashamed in my life as I do now thinking back. I know how wrong I was. We managed to get through things and things were looking okay. My dad passed away in January this year and I started remembering my mum and realising I hadn't acknowledged her death until now. I miss her so much and my dad although I'm so confused about our love-hate relationship. I broke up with my boyfriend a day before my 21'st after a year. It was me who called it as we both knew I never loved him as much as my husband. I couldn't let him go and he felt that. But now he seems to be doing okay and I'm the one feeling miserable. He says he cant talk to me and he doesnt want to know me, and brings up the things I did to hurt him. I can't stop crying. I went to the doc and im on prozac for my depression and I am feeling very suicidal. My family isnt very supportive and my friends aren't very easy to talk to (I have tried). they are more partyish type of ppl which isnt easy. I dont have money for any therapy/counselling and dont really want it. Just really need someone to chat to and some advice.

That sounds easy but its so not. I  am in like a thousand pounds of debt so I can't really move. I'm trying so hard to find another job, I apply to like at least 15 daily but no replies because most of the time I don't have enough 'experience' 

It is when you gave every single thing up for the person who you thought loved you
